svg.title: Totals count days, not demand
svg.desc: Three readings of the same days, JFK and Central Park combined, Central Park weather. Total trips: Dry 4,921,186 over 725 days, Light 948,284 over 141 days, Moderate 631,412 over 95 days, Heavy 870,865 over 131 days. Trips per day: Dry 6,788, Light 6,725, Moderate 6,646, Heavy 6,648. Against dry days in the same month and weekday: Light +0.7%, Moderate +0.1%, Heavy −0.3%. Taking the max of four stations instead labels 170 days heavy rain, not 131.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Dry days hold 67% of all trips because 66% of days were dry. Taking the wettest of four NYC stations would call 170 days heavy rain, not 131.
